shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat vertical surface
row of repeated animal figures in a frieze
justification: Both surfaces carry low-relief profile quadrupeds arranged in horizontal rows within registers, and both include a stylized tree/plant element, which is the most specific shared trait. But A shows a naturalistic procession of clothed human figures leading horned rams past a tree with fine anatomical and textile detail bordered by rosette bands, while B shows schematic, abstracted predators/birds and reptilian creatures with no humans, no garments and no floral border, in a wholly different, flattened stylistic convention.
